To cite AIPW in publications use:

  Zhong Y, Kennedy E, Bodnar L, Naimi A (2021). “AIPW: An R Package for
  Augmented Inverse Probability Weighted Estimation of Average Causal
  Effects.” _American Journal of Epidemiology_, *190*, 2690-2699. ISSN
  0002-9262, doi:10.1093/aje/kwab207
  <https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwab207>,
  <https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwab207>.

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is

  @Article{,
    title = {AIPW: An R Package for Augmented Inverse Probability Weighted Estimation of Average Causal Effects},
    author = {Yongqi Zhong and Edward H. Kennedy and Lisa M. Bodnar and Ashley I. Naimi},
    journal = {American Journal of Epidemiology},
    year = {2021},
    month = {12},
    volume = {190},
    issue = {12},
    pages = {2690-2699},
    issn = {0002-9262},
    doi = {10.1093/aje/kwab207},
    url = {https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwab207},
  }
To cite mice in publications use:

  Stef van Buuren, Karin Groothuis-Oudshoorn (2011). mice: Multivariate
  Imputation by Chained Equations in R. Journal of Statistical
  Software, 45(3), 1-67. DOI 10.18637/jss.v045.i03.

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is

  @Article{,
    title = {{mice}: Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations in R},
    author = {Stef {van Buuren} and Karin Groothuis-Oudshoorn},
    journal = {Journal of Statistical Software},
    year = {2011},
    volume = {45},
    number = {3},
    pages = {1-67},
    doi = {10.18637/jss.v045.i03},
  }
To cite package ‘SuperLearner’ in publications use:

  Polley E, LeDell E, Kennedy C, van der Laan M (2025). _SuperLearner:
  Super Learner Prediction_. R package version 2.0-40,
  <https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=SuperLearner>.

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is

  @Manual{,
    title = {SuperLearner: Super Learner Prediction},
    author = {Eric Polley and Erin LeDell and Chris Kennedy and Mark {van der Laan}},
    year = {2025},
    note = {R package version 2.0-40},
    url = {https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=SuperLearner},
  }
To cite ranger in publications use:

  Marvin N. Wright, Andreas Ziegler (2017). ranger: A Fast
  Implementation of Random Forests for High Dimensional Data in C++ and
  R. Journal of Statistical Software, 77(1), 1-17.
  doi:10.18637/jss.v077.i01

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is

  @Article{,
    title = {{ranger}: A Fast Implementation of Random Forests for High Dimensional Data in {C++} and {R}},
    author = {Marvin N. Wright and Andreas Ziegler},
    journal = {Journal of Statistical Software},
    year = {2017},
    volume = {77},
    number = {1},
    pages = {1--17},
    doi = {10.18637/jss.v077.i01},
  }
